findings.title: [P1] Parse `cached.value`, not the metadata wrapper, on cache hits
findings.body: The PR changes `Cache.get`'s return type to `{ value: string; stale: boolean } | null` (`src/cache.ts`), but the added hit path `return JSON.parse(cached);` still parses the old shape. `JSON.parse` expects a `string`, so this is a TypeScript compile error, and if executed with types stripped it coerces the wrapper to `"[object Object]"` and throws `SyntaxError` on **every** cache hit. The previous code was correct only because `get` returned the raw string. Fix: `return JSON.parse(cached.value);`.
